data.name: Setting_start_recommended_items_Description

data.name: Setting_start_recent_lists_Title

data.value: Show recent files and most-used apps in Start. Hiding them also stops Windows from tracking the documents you open for Start.

data.name: Setting_start_track_programs_Description
data.value: Let Windows remember which apps you start, so Start can rank your most-used apps. Turning it off changes that ranking.

data.name: Setting_start_account_notifications_Description
data.value: Show account messages in Start and Settings, for example offers to finish setting up your Microsoft account.

data.name: Setting_start_all_apps_view_Description
data.value: Choose how the All apps list looks in the new Start menu.

data.name: Setting_start_hide_all_apps_Description
data.value: Remove the All apps list from Start. Start then has no full list of your apps. Windows treats this as a policy for your account.

data.name: Setting_privacy_lock_screen_tips_Description
data.value: Show fun facts and tips on the lock screen. Windows may turn this on again after an update. The switch only shows in Settings when the lock screen is not Windows Spotlight.

data.name: Setting_privacy_start_suggested_content_Description
data.value: Windows uses a second switch for app suggestions in Start. Turn it off together with 'Suggestions in Start and Settings'. Windows may turn it on again after an update.

data.name: Setting_privacy_windows_tips_Title
data.value: Tips and suggestions while using Windows

data.name: Setting_privacy_windows_tips_Description
data.value: Show tips, tricks and suggestions while you use Windows. Windows may turn this on again after an update.

data.name: Setting_privacy_settings_suggestions_Description
data.value: Show suggested content in the Settings app. Windows may turn this on again after an update.

data.name: Setting_privacy_welcome_experience_Description
data.value: Show the welcome screen that can appear after Windows updates. Windows may turn this on again after an update.

data.name: Setting_privacy_get_most_out_of_windows_Title
data.value: Get the most out of Windows prompts

data.name: Setting_privacy_get_most_out_of_windows_Description
data.value: Show the prompts that offer to finish setting up your PC and your account.

data.name: Setting_privacy_suggested_toasts_Description
data.value: Show notifications that suggest features or remind you to back up. Other app notifications are not changed.

data.name: Setting_privacy_feedback_frequency_Description
data.value: Choose how often Windows asks you for feedback.

data.name: Setting_privacy_input_personalization_Description
data.value: Let Windows learn from your handwriting, typing and contacts to improve suggestions. Limiting it stops that collection.

data.name: Setting_privacy_online_speech_Description
data.value: Send your voice to Microsoft speech services to get better recognition. Turning it off also stops voice typing and dictation from working.

data.name: Setting_privacy_third_party_suggestions_Description
data.value: Stop Windows Spotlight from showing suggestions from other companies. Windows treats this as a policy for your account.

data.name: Setting_privacy_cross_device_resume_Description
data.value: Let Windows offer to continue what you did on your phone.

data.name: Setting_privacy_cloud_clipboard_upload_Title
data.value: Upload the clipboard to the cloud

data.name: Setting_privacy_cloud_clipboard_upload_Description
data.value: Let Windows upload what you copy to your account so you can paste it on other PCs.

data.name: Setting_privacy_dev_tool_telemetry_Description
data.value: Opt out of usage data from the .NET command line tools and from PowerShell by setting two user variables. Programs that are already running do not see the change.

data.name: Setting_search_box_suggestions_Description
data.value: Turn off web suggestions in the search box of File Explorer and Start. Windows treats this as a policy for your account, and the effect on Start is not confirmed by Microsoft.

data.name: Setting_search_highlights_Description
data.value: Show daily pictures and events in the search box.

data.name: Setting_taskbar_button_grouping_Description
data.value: Choose when windows of the same app share one taskbar button. This applies to the main taskbar and to the taskbars on other displays.

data.name: Setting_taskbar_multi_display_Description
data.value: Choose where taskbar buttons appear when you use more than one display.

data.name: Choice_taskbar_multi_display_main_and_open
data.value: Main display and where the window is

data.name: Setting_taskbar_notification_center_Description
data.value: Remove the notification center and the calendar flyout from the taskbar clock. Windows treats this as a policy for your account.

data.name: Setting_appearance_alt_tab_tabs_Description
data.value: Choose how many Microsoft Edge tabs show next to your windows when you press Alt+Tab or snap a window.

data.name: Setting_appearance_snap_bar_Title
data.value: Snap bar at the top of the screen

data.name: Setting_appearance_snap_bar_Description
data.value: Show the snap layouts bar when you drag a window to the top of the screen.

data.name: Setting_appearance_desktop_spotlight_Description
data.value: Use Windows Spotlight pictures on the desktop. Windows treats this as a policy for your account.

data.name: Setting_explorer_drive_letters_Description
data.value: Choose where drive letters appear in the drive names.

data.name: Setting_explorer_nav_home_Description
data.value: Show Home in the left pane of File Explorer. If you hide it, set File Explorer to open to This PC.

data.name: Setting_explorer_nav_gallery_Description
data.value: Show Gallery in the left pane of File Explorer.

data.name: Setting_explorer_nav_onedrive_Description
data.value: Show OneDrive in the left pane of File Explorer. Your OneDrive files are not touched.

data.name: Setting_explorer_classic_context_menu_Description
data.value: Show the full right-click menu at once, without 'Show more options'. This uses an unsupported registry key. Windows may ignore it after an update, and some security tools may report the key.

data.name: Setting_explorer_copy_dialog_details_Description
data.value: Show the speed graph and the details in the dialog that appears when you copy or move files.

data.name: Setting_explorer_autoplay_Description
data.value: Let Windows start an action when you connect a drive or a memory card.

data.name: Setting_desktop_unsupported_hardware_notice_Description
data.value: Show the notice that tells you this PC does not meet the Windows 11 system requirements. It only appears on such PCs.

data.name: Setting_desktop_lock_wallpaper_Description
data.value: Stop this account from changing the desktop picture. Use it on shared PCs. Settings then shows the option as managed by your organization.

data.name: Setting_input_scrollbars_Description
data.value: Choose whether scroll bars always show or hide when you do not use them. Takes effect after you sign out and in.

data.name: Setting_input_time_format_24h_Description
data.value: Show the time in 24-hour format in the taskbar clock and in apps that follow your region format. A different region format shows as a custom value.

data.name: Setting_input_mouse_acceleration_Description
data.value: Pointer acceleration makes the pointer move farther when you move the mouse faster. Turn it off for steady aim. Some people with limited hand movement depend on it.

data.name: Setting_input_keyboard_repeat_Description
data.value: Choose how long you hold a key before it starts to repeat. A short delay can cause repeated letters if you hold keys longer than you mean to.

data.name: Setting_input_accessibility_hotkeys_Description
data.value: Stop the pop-ups for Sticky Keys, Filter Keys and Toggle Keys that appear when you press Shift five times or hold a key. The features stay available in Settings.

data.name: Setting_apps_game_mode_Description
data.value: Let Windows give games more of the PC's power. Leaving it on is recommended.

data.name: Setting_apps_game_capture_Description
data.value: Let Windows record gameplay in the background and save clips with the Game Bar. Turning it off stops clip recording.

data.name: Setting_apps_new_outlook_migration_Description
data.value: Stop classic Outlook from moving you to the new Outlook by itself. It only matters when classic Outlook is installed.

data.name: Setting_performance_storage_sense_Description
data.value: Let Windows free disk space on its own by deleting temporary files and emptying the recycle bin on a schedule.

data.name: Setting_performance_app_shutdown_timeouts_Description
data.value: Choose how long Windows waits for apps to close at sign-out and shutdown. A short wait can cut off an app that is still saving. Takes effect after you sign out and in.

data.name: Setting_performance_auto_end_tasks_Title
data.value: End apps at shutdown without asking

data.name: Setting_performance_auto_end_tasks_Description
data.value: Close apps at sign-out and shutdown without asking you first. Unsaved work in those apps is lost. Takes effect after you sign out and in.

data.name: SetConditionalNote
data.value: Windows can change this value back, for example after an update. Check it again after big updates.

data.name: OptimizeAdvancedIntro
data.value: These changes can lower safety or stop features. Read each one before you change it.

data.name: OptimizeHighBody
data.value: These changes are marked high risk. They can stop features or lower the safety of this PC. You can undo them from the history, but a restart may be needed.

data.name: OptimizeHighNote
data.value: Continue only if you understand the effect of each change.

data.name: OptimizeCode_optimize_unsupported_edition
data.value: This setting does not apply to this edition of Windows.

data.name: OptimizeCode_optimize_service_in_use
data.value: Another service that is turned on needs this one. Turn that service off first.

data.name: OptimizeCode_optimize_service_not_trusted
data.value: This service does not run a Microsoft program from the Windows folder, so Winora does not change it.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_long_paths_Description
data.value: Lets programs that support it use file paths longer than 260 characters. Programs that are already open need a restart. This applies to every account on this PC.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_responsiveness_Title
data.value: CPU share kept for background work

data.name: Machine_machine_system_responsiveness_Description
data.value: Sets how much processor time Windows keeps free for background tasks while audio, video or games run. Ten percent leaves more time for the program in front. The gain is small and not measured on every PC.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_exclude_drivers_Description
data.value: Stops Windows Update from adding drivers to its monthly quality updates. You then get drivers from the maker of your hardware. Settings will say that some settings are managed by your organization.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_auto_updates_off_Description
data.value: Windows stops checking for and installing updates by itself. You get no security fixes until you check for updates by hand or undo this change. Use it only if you manage updates in another way.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_verbose_status_Description
data.value: Shows what Windows is doing while it starts, signs you in and shuts down, instead of a short message. It helps when you look for the reason for a slow start. It changes nothing else.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_consumer_features_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from installing suggested apps and showing consumer offers. Only Windows Enterprise and Education follow this policy. On Home and Pro the setting is not available.

data.name: Machine_machine_taskbar_widgets_Description
data.value: Turns off the Widgets board and its news feed for every account. The switch in Settings is then locked. Sign out or restart for the change to show.

data.name: Machine_machine_network_prefer_ipv4_Description
data.value: Makes Windows try IPv4 before IPv6 when both work. IPv6 stays on. Only one bit of the setting changes and the other bits are kept. Restart the PC for the change to take effect.

data.name: Machine_machine_ai_notepad_Description
data.value: Turns off the AI features in Notepad, such as rewrite and summarize, for every account. Newer Notepad versions follow this policy. Older ones have no AI features.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_maps_broker_Description
data.value: Windows starts this service a little after boot so offline maps can update. Manual starts it only when an app asks for it. Offline maps may update later.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_lltdsvc_Description
data.value: This service drew the old Network Map. Windows 11 has no Network Map, so most PCs do not need it. Turning it off is safe unless a program you use needs it.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_xbl_game_save_Description
data.value: Saves game progress to the Xbox cloud. Turn it off only if you do not use Xbox games, the Xbox app or Game Pass. The Xbox auth service needs this one, so turn this one off first.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_xbl_auth_manager_Description
data.value: Signs you in to Xbox services. Turning it off breaks Xbox sign-in, Game Pass and the sign-in of some games. Winora does not turn it off while the Xbox game save service is still on.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_diagtrack_Title
data.value: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry service

data.name: Machine_machine_services_diagtrack_Description
data.value: Sends diagnostic data to Microsoft. Turning it off stops that upload. Windows may help less when it fixes update problems, and feature updates can turn the service on again. The diagnostic data policy is the supported way to limit it.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_memory_integrity_Description
data.value: Turns off memory integrity (hypervisor-protected code integrity). Games and some tools run a few percent faster, but malware can load vulnerable kernel drivers. A restart is needed. Use it only if you know why you need it.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smartscreen_policy_Title
data.value: SmartScreen for apps and files (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smartscreen_policy_Description
data.value: Turns off the SmartScreen check that warns about unknown or dangerous downloads and apps. You lose a protection against malware downloads. The Windows Security page may show that a policy controls it.

data.value: Scans the drive while Windows runs. Windows may fix small errors on its own; larger ones need a restart.

data.value: Looks for damage in the component store. It takes longer than the quick check.

data.value: Repairs damage in the component store. DISM may download good files from Windows Update.

data.name: Tools_dism_restore_Changes
data.value: Replaces damaged component store files and may use the network. Run the scan first.

data.value: Clears the Store cache. The Store opens when it is done.

data.name: Tools_wsreset_Changes
data.value: Removes the Store cache. Your apps and sign-in are kept.

data.value: Sets the Winsock catalog back to the Windows default. Use it when programs cannot connect although the network works.

data.name: Tools_winsock_Changes
data.value: Removes network add-ins registered in Winsock, such as layers of some VPN, proxy or security programs. A restart is needed.

data.name: Tools_ip_Changes

data.name: Tools_ipv6_Desc
data.value: Sets the TCP/IP (IPv6) settings back to the Windows default.

data.name: Tools_ipv6_Changes
data.value: Removes fixed IPv6 addresses and similar settings you set by hand. A restart is needed.

data.name: Tools_winhttp_Desc
data.value: Removes the system-wide WinHTTP proxy so system services connect directly.

data.name: Tools_winhttp_Changes
data.value: Removes the WinHTTP proxy setting. Browser proxy settings are not changed. No restart is needed.

data.name: ToolsFeaturesIntro

data.name: Feat_NetFx3_Desc

data.name: Feat_TelnetClient_Desc
data.value: The old Telnet command line client. It sends text without encryption, so use it only on trusted networks.

data.name: Feat_SMB1Protocol_Desc
data.value: SMB 1.0 file sharing. It is old and not safe. Turn it on only for a device that cannot use a newer version, and turn it off after.

data.name: Feat_MicrosoftWindowsPowerShellV2_Desc
data.value: Windows PowerShell 2.0. It is old and lacks modern security logging. Turn it off unless an old script needs it.

data.name: Feat_Microsoft_Hyper_V_All_Desc

data.name: Feat_VirtualMachinePlatform_Desc

data.name: Feat_Microsoft_Windows_Subsystem_Linux_Desc

data.name: Feat_Containers_DisposableClientVM_Desc

data.name: Power_boost_mode_Description
data.value: How eagerly the processor goes above its base speed. Aggressive modes are faster and run hotter. Turning it off keeps the PC cooler and quieter.

data.name: Power_pcie_aspm_Description
data.value: Lets graphics cards and fast drives lower the power of their link when idle. Off can remove short pauses on some PCs but costs power. Microsoft advises most people to leave it alone.

data.name: Power_usb_suspend_Description
data.value: Lets Windows power down idle USB devices. Turn it off if a hub, audio interface or drive drops out. It costs power, most of all on battery.

data.name: Power_wake_timers_Description
data.value: Lets scheduled tasks and updates wake the PC from sleep. Turn them off to stop the PC waking at night.

data.name: Power_sleep_unattended_Title
data.value: Sleep after, when nobody is at the PC

data.name: Power_sleep_unattended_Description
data.value: How long the PC stays awake after Windows wakes it for a task and no one uses it.

data.name: PowerDcWarning
data.value: On battery, a higher-performance value here shortens battery life and adds heat.

data.name: PowerBatteryNotice
data.value: This PC has a battery. Performance changes apply to mains power only unless you pick a battery value yourself.

data.name: PowerHibernationHelp
data.value: Hibernation saves everything to a file on the system drive. Turning it off frees disk space (about 20 to 40 percent of RAM) and also turns off hybrid sleep and Fast Startup. The Fast Startup switch itself is on the Optimize page.

data.name: PowerHibernationOffBody
data.value: Windows removes the hibernation file. Hibernate, hybrid sleep and Fast Startup stop working.

data.name: PowerHibernationOnBody
data.value: Windows creates the hibernation file again at its default size.

data.name: PowerHibernationLoss
data.value: If the power fails during hybrid sleep, unsaved work can be lost.

data.name: PowerHibernationLaptop
data.value: This PC has a battery. Without hibernation a laptop cannot save its session when the battery runs out.

data.name: PowerInstallHelp
data.value: Makes a copy of the Ultimate Performance plan that is built into Windows, names it for Winora and uses it. Some editions and laptops do not have this plan. Undo switches back and deletes the copy.

data.name: PowerInstallBody

data.name: Machine_machine_system_fast_startup_Description
data.value: Saves part of the system state when you shut down, so the next start is faster. Off gives a full, clean start each time. Hibernation must be on for Fast Startup to work; you can change hibernation on the Power page. It takes effect at the next shutdown.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_activity_publish_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from sending your activity history to Microsoft, for every account on this PC. Uses the policy 'Allow publishing of User Activities'. It works with the activity feed and upload settings.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_cross_device_clipboard_Description
data.value: Stops the clipboard from syncing to your other devices, for every account on this PC. Uses the policy 'Allow Clipboard synchronization across devices'. The local clipboard keeps working.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_settings_sync_Description
data.value: Turns off Windows settings sync for every account and locks the switch in Settings. Your themes, passwords and other settings no longer follow you to your other devices. Uses the policy 'Do not sync'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_settings_sync_metered_Title
data.value: Settings sync on metered connections (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_settings_sync_metered_Description
data.value: Stops settings sync while the PC uses a metered connection, for every account. The switch in Settings is locked. Uses the policy 'Do not sync on metered connections'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_background_apps_Title
data.value: Store apps in the background (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_background_apps_Description
data.value: Forces Microsoft Store apps to stay stopped when you are not using them, for every account. Some apps then stop notifications, sync and live tiles. Uses the policy 'Let Windows apps run in the background'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_location_policy_Description
data.value: Turns off the location service for every account and locks the switch in Settings. Automatic time zone, weather, maps and Find My Device then stop working. This is stronger than the per-app location setting.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_sensors_policy_Description
data.value: Turns off all sensors for every account. Auto-rotate, ambient light and adaptive brightness can stop working on tablets and 2-in-1 PCs. Uses the policy 'Turn off sensors'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_maps_download_Title
data.value: Offline maps download and update (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_maps_download_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from downloading and updating offline map data in the background, for every account. Uses the policy 'Turn off Automatic Download and Update of Map Data'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_maps_settings_traffic_Title
data.value: Map traffic from the Settings page (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_maps_settings_traffic_Description
data.value: Stops the Offline maps page in Settings from using the network until you ask it to. Applies to every account.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_device_metadata_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from downloading device names, icons and companion apps from the internet when you plug in hardware. Uses the policy 'Prevent device metadata retrieval from the Internet'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_camera_indicator_Description
data.value: Hides the on-screen notice that appears when the camera turns on or off, for every account. Microsoft does not document this value; Winora lists it because privacy tools use it. The light on the camera is not changed.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_online_tips_Description
data.value: Stops Settings from fetching tips from Microsoft online, for every account. On recent Windows 11 builds the effect may be small.

data.name: Machine_machine_network_ncsi_active_probe_Title
data.value: Internet check by test download (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_network_ncsi_active_probe_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from testing the internet by loading a small web page. The network icon can show 'no internet' on a working connection, public Wi-Fi sign-in pages are not detected, and some Microsoft apps report errors. Microsoft advises against this.

data.name: Machine_machine_network_ncsi_passive_poll_Title
data.value: Internet check by traffic watching (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_network_ncsi_passive_poll_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from judging your internet access by watching network traffic. The network icon can show a wrong state, and apps that rely on it may report errors. Uses the policy 'Specify passive polling'.

data.name: Machine_machine_search_cloud_content_Title
data.value: Cloud content in Windows Search (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_search_cloud_content_Description
data.value: Stops Windows Search from showing results from OneDrive, SharePoint and your Microsoft or work account, for every account. Uses the policy 'Allow Cloud Search'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_wmdrm_online_Title
data.value: Windows Media DRM internet access (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_wmdrm_online_Description
data.value: Stops Windows Media DRM from going online for licenses and security updates. Old protected media files can no longer get new licenses. Files already licensed keep playing.

data.name: Machine_machine_network_smart_name_resolution_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from sending a name lookup to all network adapters at once and using the fastest answer. Names are then looked up in the normal order. This is not a leak protection and does not encrypt anything.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_find_my_device_Description
data.value: Turns off Find My Device for every account. You can no longer locate this PC if it is lost or stolen. Uses the policy 'Turn On/Off Find My Device'.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_consumer_account_content_Description
data.value: Hides Microsoft 365 and account promotions in Settings. Windows applies this policy only on Enterprise and Education editions; other editions ignore it.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_windows_tips_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from showing tips and welcome prompts, for every account. Windows applies this policy only on Enterprise and Education editions; other editions ignore it.

data.name: Machine_machine_privacy_cloud_optimized_content_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from loading cloud-optimized content such as suggestions, for every account. Windows applies this policy only on Enterprise and Education editions; other editions ignore it.

data.name: Machine_machine_ai_recall_removal_Description
data.value: Removes Recall from this PC and deletes the snapshots it saved. Deleted snapshots do not come back. Undoing this setting does not reinstall Recall; you must turn the Recall Windows feature on again. A restart is needed.

data.name: Machine_machine_ai_click_to_do_Description
data.value: Turns off Click to Do for every account. It only exists on Copilot+ PCs. Click to Do inside Recall is not changed. Sign out and back in to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_ai_paint_generative_erase_Description
data.value: Removes the Generative Erase tool from Paint for every account. Needs a Paint version that supports this policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_ai_paint_remove_background_Description
data.value: Removes the AI Remove Background tool from Paint for every account. Needs a Paint version that supports this policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_ai_copilot_sidebar_Description
data.value: Turns off the old Windows Copilot sidebar. It applies only to Windows 11 22H2 and 23H2, and Microsoft has deprecated the policy. It does nothing to the newer Copilot app; remove that app on the Bloatware page.

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_lock_screen_camera_Title
data.value: Camera on the lock screen (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_lock_screen_camera_Description
data.value: Stops anyone from turning on the camera on the lock screen. Only tablets and some 2-in-1 PCs have this feature. Uses the policy 'Prevent enabling lock screen camera'.

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_sign_in_blur_Title
data.value: Blur on the sign-in screen (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_sign_in_blur_Description
data.value: Shows a clear background on the sign-in screen instead of the blurred one. Sign out to see it. Uses the policy 'Show clear logon background'.

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_lock_screen_off_Description
data.value: Skips the lock screen and goes straight to the sign-in screen. It does not work when sign-in requires Ctrl+Alt+Del. Uses the policy 'Do not display the lock screen'.

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_lock_screen_picture_Title
data.value: Changing the lock screen picture (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_lock_screen_picture_Description
data.value: Stops users from changing the lock screen and sign-in picture. Use it on shared PCs only. The option in Settings stays locked until you undo this.

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_lock_screen_notifications_Title
data.value: App notifications on the lock screen (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_shell_lock_screen_notifications_Description
data.value: Hides app notifications on the lock screen for every account. Uses the policy 'Turn off app notifications on the lock screen'.

data.name: Machine_machine_start_hide_recommended_Description
data.value: Hides the Recommended section in the Start menu for every account. Windows may ignore this policy on some editions. Restart Explorer or sign out to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_start_hide_recent_apps_Title
data.value: Recently added apps in Start (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_start_hide_recent_apps_Description
data.value: Hides the list of recently added apps in the Start menu for every account. Restart Explorer or sign out to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_settings_home_Title
data.value: Home page of the Settings app (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_system_settings_home_Description
data.value: Hides the Home page of the Settings app for every account. If another tool already set a list of visible or hidden pages, Winora shows it as a custom value and does not overwrite it.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_menu_ask_copilot_Title
data.value: 'Ask Copilot' in the right-click menu (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_menu_ask_copilot_Description
data.value: Removes 'Ask Copilot' from the right-click menu in File Explorer for every account. Nothing is deleted; the menu entry is only blocked. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_menu_give_access_Title
data.value: 'Give access to' in the right-click menu (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_menu_give_access_Description
data.value: Removes 'Give access to' from the right-click menu in File Explorer for every account. Nothing is deleted; the menu entry is only blocked. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_menu_include_library_Title
data.value: 'Include in library' in the right-click menu (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_menu_include_library_Description
data.value: Removes 'Include in library' from the right-click menu in File Explorer for every account. Nothing is deleted; the menu entry is only blocked. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_menu_share_Description
data.value: Removes 'Share' from the right-click menu in File Explorer for every account. Nothing is deleted; the menu entry is only blocked. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_autoplay_drives_Description
data.value: Turns off AutoPlay on every type of drive for every account. The AutoPlay page in Settings is locked. Uses the policy 'Turn off Autoplay'.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_autorun_commands_Description
data.value: Never runs the autorun.inf commands of a disk or USB drive, for every account. Uses the policy 'Set the default behavior for AutoRun'.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_autoplay_devices_Title
data.value: AutoPlay for cameras and phones (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_autoplay_devices_Description
data.value: Turns off AutoPlay for cameras, phones and other devices that are not drives, for every account. Uses the policy 'Disallow Autoplay for non-volume devices'.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_desktop_Title
data.value: Desktop folder under This PC (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_desktop_Description
data.value: Hides the Desktop folder in the This PC view of File Explorer for every account. The folder and its files stay where they are. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_documents_Title
data.value: Documents folder under This PC (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_documents_Description
data.value: Hides the Documents folder in the This PC view of File Explorer for every account. The folder and its files stay where they are. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_downloads_Title
data.value: Downloads folder under This PC (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_downloads_Description
data.value: Hides the Downloads folder in the This PC view of File Explorer for every account. The folder and its files stay where they are. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_music_Title
data.value: Music folder under This PC (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_music_Description
data.value: Hides the Music folder in the This PC view of File Explorer for every account. The folder and its files stay where they are. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_pictures_Title
data.value: Pictures folder under This PC (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_pictures_Description
data.value: Hides the Pictures folder in the This PC view of File Explorer for every account. The folder and its files stay where they are. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_videos_Title
data.value: Videos folder under This PC (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_thispc_videos_Description
data.value: Hides the Videos folder in the This PC view of File Explorer for every account. The folder and its files stay where they are. Restart Explorer to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_nav_network_Title
data.value: Network in the navigation pane (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_nav_network_Description
data.value: Hides Network in the left pane of File Explorer for every account. Restart Explorer to see the change. The Network icon on the desktop is a different setting.

data.name: Machine_machine_explorer_shortcut_arrow_Description
data.value: Replaces the arrow on shortcut icons with a blank icon, for every account. Microsoft does not document this tweak. Restart Explorer or rebuild the icon cache to see the change.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_developer_mode_Description
data.value: Sets the Developer Mode value. It lets you install apps that are not from the Store, which lowers app install security. The Settings page also installs the Developer Mode package; this value alone does not.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_sideload_apps_Title
data.value: Install apps from outside the Store (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_system_sideload_apps_Description
data.value: Allows apps from outside the Store that have a trusted certificate, for every account. This lowers app install security. Turn it on only if you need it.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_insider_builds_Description
data.value: Blocks Insider preview builds on this PC. A PC that is already in the Insider program must leave it first, or this setting does not remove the builds. Uses the policy 'Toggle user control over Insider builds'.

data.name: Machine_machine_apps_push_to_install_Description
data.value: Stops the Store website and Store apps on other devices from pushing app installs to this PC. Uses the policy 'Turn off Push To Install service'.

data.name: Machine_machine_apps_teams_install_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from installing the Microsoft Teams chat app by itself for new accounts. The source of this value is a community tool, not a Microsoft page.

data.name: Machine_machine_apps_game_recording_policy_Description
data.value: Sets the policy that turns off Game Bar recording and broadcasting, for every account. Microsoft lists this policy as enforced on Windows 10; on Windows 11 the effect may be small.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_wpbt_execution_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from running programs that the PC firmware hands to it at boot (WPBT). Some makers use this for anti-theft tools or drivers, and those then stop working. Support on Windows 11 24H2 and later is not confirmed. A restart is needed.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_wer_disabled_Description
data.value: Turns off Windows Error Reporting. Windows no longer sends crash reports to Microsoft. Crash dumps are still written locally.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_wer_no_prompt_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from asking you whether to send an error report. Reports are handled without a question.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_wer_no_extra_Title
data.value: Extra data in error reports (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_system_wer_no_extra_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from adding extra data, such as memory contents, to error reports. The basic report is still sent unless you also turn the reporting off.

data.name: Machine_machine_performance_ntfs_last_access_Description
data.value: Stops NTFS from updating the last-access time each time a file is read. This saves a few disk writes. Some backup and search tools use that time. Windows may set the value back after a restart. A restart is needed.

data.name: Machine_machine_performance_ntfs_short_names_Description
data.value: Stops NTFS from creating old-style 8.3 short names on all drives. Existing short names stay. Very old installers and programs may fail. A restart is needed.

data.name: Machine_machine_network_webdav_file_limit_Description
data.value: Raises the largest file that Windows can copy over WebDAV from about 50 MB to 4 GB. Useful only if you open files from a WebDAV share. Restart the WebClient service or the PC to apply it.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_crash_details_Title
data.value: Technical details on the blue screen (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_system_crash_details_Description
data.value: Shows the stop code and the failing driver on the blue screen when Windows crashes. Takes effect at the next crash.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_crash_no_emoticon_Title
data.value: Sad face on the blue screen (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_system_crash_no_emoticon_Description
data.value: Hides the sad face on the blue screen. Takes effect at the next crash.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_remote_assistance_Description
data.value: Stops this PC from accepting Remote Assistance help requests. Quick Assist and Remote Desktop are not changed.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_remote_assistance_control_Title
data.value: Remote control in Remote Assistance (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_system_remote_assistance_control_Description
data.value: Stops a helper from taking control of this PC in Remote Assistance. They can still view the screen if invitations are on.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_device_encryption_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from turning on device encryption by itself. It does not decrypt a drive that is already encrypted. A lost laptop would then not be encrypted by default.

data.name: Machine_machine_power_standby_network_ac_Title
data.value: Network during standby, plugged in (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_power_standby_network_ac_Description
data.value: Turns off the network while the PC sleeps on power. Only PCs with Modern Standby (S0) are affected. Mail, chat and calls will not arrive during sleep.

data.name: Machine_machine_power_standby_network_dc_Title
data.value: Network during standby, on battery (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_power_standby_network_dc_Description
data.value: Turns off the network while the PC sleeps on battery. Only PCs with Modern Standby (S0) are affected. Mail, chat and calls will not arrive during sleep, and the battery lasts longer.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_clock_utc_Description
data.value: Makes Windows read the PC clock as UTC, as Linux does. Use it only when you dual boot with Linux. On a PC with Windows only, the clock will be wrong by your time zone offset. Microsoft does not document this value. A restart is needed.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_nvidia_dlss_indicator_Description
data.value: Shows or hides the DLSS notice that NVIDIA drivers draw in games. It needs an NVIDIA GPU; on other PCs it does nothing. 'Off' hides the notice and 'All DLSS' shows it for every DLSS version.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_first_run_Description
data.value: Skips the first-run welcome and setup screens in Microsoft Edge for every account. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_recommendations_Description
data.value: Stops Microsoft Edge from showing recommendations and promotions, for every account. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_new_tab_content_Description
data.value: Hides the news and content feed on the Microsoft Edge new tab page, for every account. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_shopping_Description
data.value: Turns off the shopping assistant in Microsoft Edge, for every account. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_personalized_ads_Title
data.value: Edge personalized ads and news (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_personalized_ads_Description
data.value: Stops Microsoft Edge from using your browsing history to personalize ads, search and news, for every account. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_diagnostic_data_Description
data.value: Limits the diagnostic data that Microsoft Edge sends to the required data only, for every account. Microsoft advises against turning diagnostic data off completely, so this setting keeps the required level. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_startup_boost_Description
data.value: Stops Microsoft Edge from preloading at sign-in, for every account. Edge may open a little slower, and it uses no memory when closed. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_background_mode_Description
data.value: Stops Microsoft Edge from running in the background after you close it, for every account. Web notifications stop when Edge is closed. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_sync_Description
data.value: Turns off sync in Microsoft Edge (favorites, passwords, history), for every account. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_sign_in_Description
data.value: Blocks sign-in to Microsoft Edge with an account, for every account. Users cannot use a profile with sync. This also blocks sync. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Restart Edge to apply.

data.name: UpdatesRefreshHelp

data.name: UpdatesOrgBody
data.value: Some update settings come from Group Policy, device management or another tool, not from Winora. Winora does not change them. A mode that needs another value for one of them cannot be applied.

data.name: UpdatesPausedSecurity

data.name: UpdatesRestartBody
data.value: Windows has an update that waits for a restart.

data.name: UpdatesMode_NoDrivers
data.value: No driver updates through Windows Update

data.name: UpdatesModeDesc_NoDrivers
data.value: Windows Update stops adding drivers to quality updates. You get drivers from the maker of your hardware. Everything else stays at the Windows default.

data.name: UpdatesModeDesc_Security
data.value: Feature updates wait for a number of days so others can find the problems first. Quality updates, which carry the security fixes, wait only a few days.

data.name: UpdatesModeDesc_Pin
data.value: Keeps the PC on Windows 11 {0} and does not move it to a newer release. Security updates stop when Microsoft ends support for {0}.

data.name: UpdatesModeDesc_PinNoRelease
data.value: Keeps the PC on its current Windows 11 release and does not move it to a newer release. Security updates stop when Microsoft ends support for that release.

data.name: UpdatesModeDesc_Notify
data.value: Windows asks before it downloads updates and again before it installs them. You decide when. Nothing happens by itself.

data.name: UpdatesModeDesc_AutomaticOff
data.value: Windows stops looking for and installing updates by itself. The PC gets no security fixes until you turn this off or install updates by hand. Use it only for a short time.

data.name: UpdatesApplyHelp
data.value: Shows every value this mode sets and asks once before anything changes.

data.name: UpdatesDaysHelp
data.value: Choose how many days Windows waits. The list has fixed steps.

data.name: UpdatesExcludeDrivers
data.value: Also leave drivers out of Windows Update

data.name: UpdatesPauseBody
data.value: Windows Settings can pause updates for a limited time, up to about five weeks. The pause is a date that Windows Settings keeps, so Winora does not write it. Pause in Settings, then come back here: the banner at the top shows the date.

data.name: UpdatesOpenSettingsHelp
data.value: Opens the Windows Update page of Windows Settings.

data.name: UpdatesOpenSettingsFailed
data.value: Windows Settings could not be opened.

data.name: UpdatesAdvancedIntro
data.value: A mode in this section lowers protection. It asks for a second confirmation.

data.name: UpdatesApplyBody
data.value: Winora will set these values together. Nothing else changes.

data.name: UpdatesWarn_WindowsDefault
data.value: Windows decides by itself when to check, download and install updates.

data.name: UpdatesWarn_NoDrivers
data.value: Drivers no longer come through Windows Update. Get them from the maker of your hardware. Settings will say that some settings are managed by your organization.

data.name: UpdatesWarn_Security
data.value: Updates arrive later. A delayed quality update leaves the PC open to known security problems for the days you chose.

data.name: UpdatesWarn_Pin
data.value: Windows will not move this PC to a newer release. Security updates stop when Microsoft ends support for the release.

data.name: UpdatesWarn_Notify
data.value: Updates wait until you agree to download and install them. If you forget, the PC stays without the fixes.

data.name: UpdatesWarn_AutomaticOff

data.name: Machine_machine_services_ax_installer_Description
data.value: Installs ActiveX controls for Internet Explorer mode and very old web pages. Most PCs never need it. With it off, ActiveX installs fail.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_geolocation_Description
data.value: Tells apps where this PC is. With it off, Maps, weather, Find my device and automatic time zone stop working, and so does any other app that asks for your location. The location privacy switches already limit apps, so try those first. Windows starts this service only when an app needs it.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_upnp_host_Description
data.value: Lets this PC host UPnP devices. With it off, casting to TVs and speakers can break, and some printers and smart devices may not be found. Turn this one off before the SSDP Discovery service, which it depends on.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_ssdp_Description
data.value: Finds UPnP devices on your network. With it off, casting, media sharing and the discovery of some printers and smart devices can break. Winora refuses this change while the UPnP Device Host service is still on, so turn that one off first.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_offline_files_Description
data.value: Keeps copies of network files so you can use them without a connection. With it off, Offline Files, Sync Center and cached redirected folders stop working on a company network. Home PCs rarely use it.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_insider_service_Description
data.value: Handles enrollment in the Windows Insider program. With it off, the Insider page in Settings stops working. A PC that is enrolled should leave the program first.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_phone_service_Description
data.value: Manages the phone state for calling apps. With it off, calls in some voice apps and in Phone Link may stop working. This is not tested on every Windows build.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_bluetooth_support_Description
data.value: Warning: every Bluetooth device needs this service. If this PC has Bluetooth, turning it off breaks Bluetooth mice, keyboards, headsets and file transfer. Turn it off only on a PC with no Bluetooth radio. Winora cannot check this for you.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_compat_assistant_Description
data.value: Shows advice when an old app has problems and applies compatibility fixes. Manual starts it only when Windows needs it. You may lose the compatibility prompts for old apps. Windows 11 normally uses a delayed start.

data.name: Machine_machine_services_print_spooler_Description
data.value: Warning: turning this service off stops all printing on this PC, including PDF and XPS printers and some scanners. Microsoft named it as a workaround for the PrintNightmare flaw, which current Windows updates already fix. Turn it off only on a PC with no printer. Manual is not a safe middle step, because nothing starts the service on demand.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_ssl2_client_Description
data.value: Blocks SSL 2.0 when this PC connects to other servers. Windows 11 already keeps it off by default, so this row only makes sure it stays off. Almost nothing needs it today. Services must restart to pick it up, so restart the PC. Use this only if you know why you need it.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_ssl2_server_Description
data.value: Blocks SSL 2.0 when other devices connect to services on this PC. Windows 11 already keeps it off by default, so this row only makes sure it stays off. Services must restart to pick it up, so restart the PC. Use this only if you know why you need it.

data.value: Windows wipes the page file when you shut down, so nobody can read old memory from it on another system. Shutdown takes longer, from a few seconds to several minutes, depending on the page file size. It does not help if someone cuts the power. It applies at the next shutdown.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_mrt_offer_Title
data.value: Malicious Software Removal Tool through Windows Update (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_security_mrt_offer_Description
data.value: Warning: Windows Update stops offering the monthly Malicious Software Removal Tool. That tool removes common active malware, so you lose one cleanup step. Use it only if another security product does this job.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_device_coinstallers_Description
data.value: Warning: some drivers use extra helper steps (co-installers) to finish setting up a device. With this off, those drivers install without the helper steps and the hardware may work only in part. It affects every device you plug in later.

data.name: Machine_machine_system_unsupported_upgrade_Title
data.value: In-place upgrade on an unsupported TPM or CPU (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_system_unsupported_upgrade_Description
data.value: Warning: lets Windows Setup upgrade this PC in place even when its TPM or CPU is not supported. Microsoft may not support the PC afterwards and may stop sending updates. The newest versions still need CPU features that this value cannot bypass. It acts only while Setup runs.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_update_default_Description
data.value: Warning: Edge and the WebView2 runtime stop getting updates. Apps that show web pages through WebView2 then miss security fixes too. Use it only if you update Edge in another way.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_update_check_period_Title
data.value: How often Microsoft Edge checks for updates (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_update_check_period_Description
data.value: Warning: Edge stops looking for updates by itself. Edge and the WebView2 runtime then miss security fixes until you update them by hand. Use it only if you update Edge in another way.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_defer_quality_Description
data.value: Turns on the delay for monthly security and quality updates. Set the number of days in the next row. Security fixes arrive that many days late. Settings will say that your organization manages some settings.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_defer_quality_days_Description
data.value: How many days Windows waits before it installs monthly quality updates. Windows allows 0 to 30 days. It works only when the switch row above is on. A longer delay leaves known security holes open for longer.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_defer_feature_Description
data.value: Turns on the delay for big yearly feature updates. Set the number of days in the next row. Do not combine it with pinning a version, because the pin wins. Settings will say that your organization manages some settings.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_defer_feature_days_Description
data.value: How many days Windows waits before it offers a new feature update. Windows allows 0 to 365 days. It works only when the switch row above is on. Each Windows version gets security fixes only for a limited time.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_target_release_Title
data.value: Stay on one Windows version: switch

data.name: Machine_machine_update_target_release_Description
data.value: Keeps this PC on the Windows version chosen in the 'version' row. Set that row and the 'product' row too, because Windows needs all three. Warning: when that version reaches the end of its support, the PC gets no more security updates until you change it.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_target_release_version_Title
data.value: Stay on one Windows version: version

data.name: Machine_machine_update_target_release_version_Description
data.value: The Windows version the PC should stay on. Pick a version that is not older than the one installed now. It works only when the switch row and the product row are set too. When that version reaches the end of its support, the PC gets no more security updates.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_target_release_product_Title
data.value: Stay on one Windows version: product

data.name: Machine_machine_update_target_release_product_Description
data.value: Names the Windows product for the version pin. Windows needs it together with the switch row and the version row. Without it the pin does nothing.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_au_notify_Title
data.value: Ask before downloading or installing updates

data.name: Machine_machine_update_au_notify_Description
data.value: Windows asks you before it downloads or installs updates. Updates then wait for you, so install them by hand soon. Home editions mostly ignore this setting. Windows applies it only while the 'Turn off automatic updates' row is not set.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_au_notify_Choice_ask_install
data.value: Download, then tell me before installing

data.name: Machine_machine_update_wake_for_updates_Title
data.value: Wake the PC to install updates

data.name: Machine_machine_update_wake_for_updates_Description
data.value: Stops Windows from waking a sleeping PC to install updates. Updates then install the next time you use the PC. Home editions mostly ignore this setting.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_no_auto_reboot_Description
data.value: Windows does not restart by itself after an update while someone is signed in. Updates stay pending until you restart, so restart soon. Windows honors this fully only on some editions.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_no_auto_reboot_Choice_no_restart
data.value: No restart while someone is signed in

data.name: Machine_machine_update_optional_content_Title
data.value: Get the latest updates as soon as they are available

data.name: Machine_machine_update_optional_content_Description
data.value: The Windows Update switch with the same name. Off waits for the normal schedule for new features. On gives you new features earlier. The default depends on the device, and Windows may ignore the value on some builds.

data.name: Machine_machine_update_block_update_page_Description
data.value: Warning: the Windows Update page in Settings can no longer check for, download or install updates. You then get no security fixes through that page. Use it only if another tool manages your updates.

data.name: TaskWarn_appraiser_exp
data.value: This task runs extra compatibility checks that Windows uses before a feature update. With it off, upgrades can be slower or can miss a problem.

data.name: TaskWarn_disk_resolver
data.value: This task helps Windows find the cause of disk problems. With it off, you get less help when a disk starts to fail.

data.name: TaskWarn_diagnosis_scheduled
data.value: This task runs the regular Windows maintenance checks that find and fix some problems on their own. With it off, those automatic fixes and notices stop.

data.name: Machine_machine_graphics_amd_ulps_Description
data.value: ULPS puts extra AMD graphics cards to sleep when they are idle. Turning it off is a community fix for some screen sleep, wake and multi-monitor problems. It is not a speed tweak. Winora changes the value only if the AMD driver already created it, and only for the card you pick. A driver update can set it back. Idle power use goes up a little. Not advised on laptops. AMD does not document this value.

data.name: Machine_machine_graphics_nvidia_fixed_pstate_Description
data.value: Warning: this keeps the NVIDIA graphics card at its top performance state all the time. This is a community method. NVIDIA does not document it, and it was not tested on the newest cards. Idle power use and heat go up a lot, and a laptop battery drains faster. It does not help on laptops that switch between two graphics cards. Use it on a desktop PC only. Try the NVIDIA Control Panel setting Prefer maximum performance first. A restart is needed. The change is written only to the NVIDIA card you pick.

data.name: Machine_machine_graphics_hardware_gpu_scheduling_Description
data.value: Lets the graphics card schedule its own work. It needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later, a supported card and a driver that offers it. Settings, System, Display, Graphics shows the switch only when your PC supports it, so use that switch if you can. Tests show no clear gain in most games. Some drivers have caused stutter or freezes. A restart is needed.

data.name: Machine_machine_graphics_multiplane_overlay_Description
data.value: Turns off Multiplane Overlay in the desktop window manager. Use it only to test or fix flicker, black or white flashes or stutter on some NVIDIA and AMD systems. It is not a speed tweak. Windows loses some power savings, and the problem may only be hidden, not fixed. Microsoft does not document this value. A restart is needed. Choose Windows default to undo it.

data.name: Machine_machine_graphics_gpu_timeout_Description
data.value: Warning: this sets how many seconds Windows waits for the graphics card before it resets the driver. The default is 2 seconds. A longer time can stop resets during long render or compute jobs. Microsoft says normal users should not change it, because a longer wait also makes a real hang last longer. A restart is needed.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_feedback_Description
data.value: Hides the Send feedback command of Microsoft Edge, for every account. Edge no longer sends feedback, surveys or problem reports to Microsoft. Restart Edge to apply. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_alternate_error_pages_Title
data.value: Edge suggestions on error pages (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_alternate_error_pages_Description
data.value: Stops Microsoft Edge from asking a Microsoft web service for similar pages when a page cannot be found, for every account. Edge shows a plain error page instead. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_spotlight_Description
data.value: Turns off custom background images, suggestions, notifications and tips for Microsoft services in Microsoft Edge, for every account. Restart Edge to apply. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_sidebar_Description
data.value: Hides the sidebar on the right side of Microsoft Edge, for every account. Since Edge 141 the Copilot button in the toolbar has its own policy, so this row may not hide it. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_rewards_Description
data.value: Hides Microsoft Rewards offers and notifications in Microsoft Edge, for every account. Restart Edge to apply. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_top_sites_Description
data.value: Hides the default site tiles that Microsoft Edge puts on the new tab page, for every account. Sites you add yourself stay. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'.

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_do_not_track_Title
data.value: Edge Do Not Track request (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_edge_do_not_track_Description
data.value: Makes Microsoft Edge always ask websites not to track you, for every account. Many websites ignore this request. Edge then shows 'Managed by your organization'.

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_metrics_Title
data.value: Chrome usage and crash reports (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_metrics_Description
data.value: Stops Google Chrome from sending usage statistics and crash reports to Google, for every account. It has an effect only when Google Chrome is installed. Chrome then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Check the result on the page chrome://policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_url_data_Description
data.value: Stops Google Chrome from sending the addresses of the pages you visit to Google to improve search and browsing, for every account. It has an effect only when Google Chrome is installed. Chrome then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Check the result on the page chrome://policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_background_mode_Title
data.value: Chrome running in the background (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_background_mode_Description
data.value: Stops Google Chrome and its apps from running in the background after you close the last window, for every account. Chrome starts a little slower. It has an effect only when Google Chrome is installed. Chrome then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Check the result on the page chrome://policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_shopping_Description
data.value: Turns off the shopping list and price tracking features of Google Chrome, for every account. It has an effect only when Google Chrome is installed. Chrome then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Check the result on the page chrome://policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_feedback_Description
data.value: Hides the feedback command of Google Chrome, for every account. Chrome no longer sends feedback to Google. It has an effect only when Google Chrome is installed. Chrome then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Check the result on the page chrome://policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_promotions_Description
data.value: Stops Google Chrome from showing promotional and educational content, for every account. It has an effect only when Google Chrome is installed. Chrome then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Check the result on the page chrome://policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_alternate_error_pages_Title
data.value: Chrome suggestions on error pages (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_chrome_alternate_error_pages_Description
data.value: Stops Google Chrome from asking a Google web service for similar pages when a page cannot be found, for every account. It has an effect only when Google Chrome is installed. Chrome then shows 'Managed by your organization'. Check the result on the page chrome://policy.

data.name: Machine_machine_network_llmnr_Title
data.value: Local name lookup by multicast, LLMNR (all users)

data.name: Machine_machine_network_llmnr_Description
data.value: Turns off Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution on every network adapter. Another device on the local network can then no longer answer a failed name lookup with a fake address. On a small network without a DNS server, finding other PCs by name may stop working; DNS and mDNS still work. Uses the policy 'Turn off multicast name resolution'.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb1_server_Title
data.value: Old file sharing protocol SMB 1 for shared folders

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb1_server_Description
data.value: Turns off SMB version 1 in the file sharing server of this PC. SMB 1 is old and unsafe. Windows 11 does not install it by default, so this row usually changes nothing. Very old devices that open shared folders on this PC with SMB 1 stop working. Restart Windows to apply.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb_client_signing_Title
data.value: Signed file sharing traffic when this PC connects

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb_client_signing_Description
data.value: Makes this PC always sign SMB traffic when it opens shared folders on other devices. This blocks tampering and relay attacks. Windows 11 24H2 already requires it by default. Some NAS boxes, guest shares and older devices that cannot sign will stop working. Restart Windows to apply. Uses the security option 'Microsoft network client: Digitally sign communications (always)'.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb_server_signing_Title
data.value: Signed file sharing traffic for shared folders

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb_server_signing_Description
data.value: Makes the file sharing server of this PC always require signed SMB traffic. This blocks tampering and relay attacks. Windows 11 24H2 already requires it by default. Old devices and programs that cannot sign can no longer open shared folders on this PC. Restart Windows to apply. Uses the security option 'Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)'.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb_insecure_guest_Title
data.value: Guest access to shared folders without a password

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb_insecure_guest_Description
data.value: Stops this PC from opening shared folders as a guest without a user name and password. Guest access has no signing and no encryption, so others on the network can read or change the data. Many home NAS boxes use guest access; give them a user account first. Uses the policy 'Enable insecure guest logons'.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_smb_mailslots_Description
data.value: Turns off remote mailslots, an old message channel that goes through the file sharing client. Modern programs do not use it. Some very old programs that browse the network may stop working. Needs Windows 11 24H2 or later. Uses the policy 'Enable remote mailslots'.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_password_reveal_Description
data.value: Hides the eye button that shows a typed password in Windows password boxes, for every account. Someone near the screen can no longer reveal a password you typed. Uses the policy 'Do not display the password reveal button'.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_enumerate_admins_Title
data.value: Administrator list on the elevation prompt

data.name: Machine_machine_security_enumerate_admins_Description
data.value: Makes sure the elevation prompt never lists the administrator accounts of this PC. A user must type an administrator name and password. This is already the Windows default; the row fixes it as a policy. Uses the policy 'Enumerate administrator accounts on elevation'.

data.name: Machine_machine_security_printer_driver_admin_Title
data.value: Printer driver install from print servers

data.name: Machine_machine_security_printer_driver_admin_Description
data.value: Makes sure only administrators can install printer drivers from a print server (Point and Print). This blocks a known way to run harmful code. Windows already does this by default since 2021; the row fixes it as a value. Users without administrator rights then need help to add a new network printer.
